text: 记者获悉，申万宏源证券已开始执行第三批次互换便利操作。公司表示，会持续发挥好互换便利政策工具稳定市场功能，持续推进互换便利资金买入A股股票及基金，为维护资本市场平稳健康发展贡献力量。截至目前，前两批次互换便利额度已全部用于投资A股及股票ETF。（财联社）
text_en: The reporter learned that Shenwan Hongyuan Securities has begun executing the third batch of swap facility operations. The company said it will continue to leverage the market-stabilizing function of the swap facility policy tool, continue to use swap facility funds to buy A-share stocks and funds, and contribute to safeguarding the steady and healthy development of the capital market. As of now, the first two batches of swap facility quotas have been fully used to invest in A-shares and stock ETFs. (Cailian Press)
